metadata.title: Features
metadata.description: Discover everything Joutes offers for your trading card game passion: collection tracking, wishlists, play groups and their public page, game venues, events and more.

hero.title: for all your trading card games
hero.subtitle: Card catalogs, collection tracking, wishlists, play groups and their public page, game venues, events… Joutes brings together everything you need to live your TCG passion, solo or with friends.

games.title: A hub for all your games
games.description: Browse card catalogs across multiple TCGs, search by name, set or type, and find everything you need in one place.
bullets: Instant search within each game
Game pages with news, rules and tools
Built to welcome new games over time

cards.title: Card pages that get straight to the point
cards.description: Every card shows its game-specific properties (domains, traits, cost, might…) along with its errata, rulings and clarifications, sorted intelligently.
bullets: Properties tailored to each game
Community-voted errata and rulings
Outdated content is automatically pushed to the bottom

collection.title: Your collection, tracked down to the smallest detail
collection.description: Add your cards with language, condition, foil or purchase price, and track your progress toward the master set and game set of each expansion.
bullets: Detailed completion per set and per game
Foil, language, condition, grading, acquisition price
Variants (alt-arts) automatically grouped together

playGroups.title: Your play group gets its Workbench
playGroups.description: One group, one page: upcoming sessions, availability polls, announcements and the group's lists, all readable at a glance — with no chat thread to scroll back through.
bullets: Sessions set on a known date, or opened as an availability poll
In, maybe, out: everyone answers and the count keeps itself
Session venue: a Joutes location with its own page, a free-form place, or a member's home
Group announcements, members-only or carried over to the public page
Founder, admin and member roles, invitations by username or email
Shared collection, wishlists and the group's sale list
Trades matched on their own: who is after a card, who is selling it

groupShowcase.title: A public page in your group's name
groupShowcase.description: A group is no longer just a private space: it has a public page, in its own colors, that players can follow. Your sessions and internal announcements stay internal.
bullets: Logo, banner and accent color: the Workbench and the public page take your colors
Tagline, description, usual rhythm and links to your networks
Followers who subscribe to the group and see what it publishes
Tournament record, games and venues, carried over to the public page
Roll of arms: public groups are found by activity, by distance or by how new they are
Private group: it leaves the roll of arms, and its page asks not to be indexed

groupContents.title: Articles, videos and live streams
groupContents.description: What your group produces finally has somewhere to live: articles written in markdown, videos and replays, and your Twitch or YouTube streams announced at the top of the public page.
bullets: Articles written in markdown, with summary, thumbnail and related game
YouTube or Twitch videos and replays, with their running time
All, videos, articles and replays filters on the public page
Up to three simultaneous streams declared by members, viewer counts included
Streams and posts also surface on the roll of arms

wishlists.title: Wishlists that do the work for you
wishlists.description: Create as many lists as you like, across every game, with private, unlisted or public visibility. Joutes shows at a glance what you already own.
bullets: Real-time "already owned" indicator
One-click add from your collection or a card page
Text export to share your list instantly

lairs.title: Game venues, turned into showcases
lairs.description: A venue's page is no longer a listing: it is its showcase, with news, an agenda, the games played there and a proper introduction — plus its live stream at the top of the page whenever it is broadcasting.
bullets: Four tabs: news, agenda, games played here, about
Venue news, one of them pinned, and a featured event
Agenda filtered on the games you follow, sign-up in seconds
Today's opening hours, directions, photos and amenities
Follow a venue to receive its announcements

decks.title: Build and validate your decks
decks.description: Build your decks and check their legality against the game's rules, right inside the app.
bullets: Automatic legality checker
Public or private sharing
A solid base to prepare for tournaments

leagues.title: Leagues and matches, no spreadsheet needed
leagues.description: Track your leagues, log your matches and standings, without needing a shared spreadsheet.
bullets: Automatically calculated standings
Full match history
Multiple formats (points, elimination…)

metadata.title: Joutes for organizers
metadata.description: Your venue's showcase, calendar, registrations, tournaments, leagues and integrations: everything you need to talk to your players and fill your tables — stores, clubs, organizers and publishers.

hero.title: not your spreadsheets
hero.subtitle: Turn your venue's page into a showcase, publish your calendar, open registrations, run your tournaments and leagues. Joutes reaches your players where they already are: Discord, mobile, web, notifications.

audience.title: Built for the people who make the games happen
audience.subtitle: The same platform, whether you open three tables on a Friday night or a full season of tournaments.

stores.title: Game stores
stores.description: A showcase in your own brand, your weekly schedule visible to players nearby, and your registrations kept up to date without a paper sign-up sheet.

associations.title: Clubs and associations
associations.description: A shared calendar, members notified automatically, and leagues that survive a whole season without a group spreadsheet.

organizers.title: Independent organizers
organizers.description: A complete tournament — registrations, pairings, timer, standings — with nothing to install, and players joining by QR code.

publishers.title: Publishers and distributors
publishers.description: Your official events relayed to the whole network, and an open API to plug them into your own tools.

lairPage.title: Your venue's page becomes your showcase
lairPage.description: It used to be a listing with an address and a list of events. It is now the page where you talk to your players: four tabs, your news, your brand, and your live stream at the top of the page whenever you are broadcasting.
bullets: Four tabs — news, agenda, games played here, about — each with its own column of practical information
Venue news: closures, new stock, promotions, with one announcement pinned at the top
A featured event of your choosing, with its remaining seats and its sign-up button
Twitch or YouTube stream: paste a URL and the player moves to the top of the page for every visitor
Opening hours day by day, split hours included, with "open until 7pm" worked out for the visitor
Usual rhythm: what players find here on a Friday night, even with no event listed
Markdown introduction, photo gallery, amenities, public transport access and parking
Your team named, your links and networks, your Discord
Followers who subscribe to the venue and receive its announcements
pro: Logo and accent color: the page takes your colors, down to the cards and buttons
The order of the page's sections, set by you
Introduction video embedded in the "About" tab

calendar.title: A calendar your players already check
calendar.description: Your events do not sit on an isolated page: they land in the public Joutes calendar, on your venue's page, in per-game search and in search around a location.
bullets: Public monthly calendar, filterable by game
Location-based search: your events found “near me”
Full listing: schedule, price, description, link and remaining seats
Attached to your venue and its practical details
“Sold out” or “cancelled” status readable at a glance
Pages indexed and declared to search engines

engagement.title: One announcement, every channel
engagement.description: Your players do not all live in the same place. The same event is published to your Discord server, in the mobile app, on the web, and even to the AI assistants some of them use.
bullets: Discord bot: an event board posted in your channel and updated on its own
One-click registration from Discord for linked accounts
Mobile and desktop app: calendar, player portal, notifications
In-app notifications and push notifications on phones
Weekly digest by email and notification
MCP server and WebMCP tools: your events answer compatible AI assistants

registrations.title: Registrations, without rereading a chat thread
registrations.description: Who is registered, who is still waiting for approval, who has arrived, who has handed in a decklist: it all reads from a single page, and your participants are told as soon as anything changes.
bullets: Registration from the web, from Discord or from mobile
Capped seat count, with a live tally
Pre-registration: you approve each request one by one
Check-in on the day of the event
Custom registration form: text, number, choice, a card from the game, decklist parsed automatically
Answer deadline, with late answers flagged as such
Event cancelled: every registered player is notified, reason included
Organizer announcements pushed to participants
soon: Automatic waiting list that promotes the next player as soon as a seat frees up

tournaments.title: The tournament runs itself
tournaments.description: You start the round, Joutes does the rest: pairings, tables, a timer broadcast to the whole room, results reported by players and standings recomputed on every match.
bullets: Chained phases: Swiss rounds, elimination, seeded bracket, freeform, time race
Pairings generated automatically, top cut between two phases
Configurable tiebreakers: opponents' win rate (OMW), game difference, game statistics
Timer broadcast to everyone, time extensions granted table by table
Room screen to project: timer, announcements, standings or pairings
“Info” or “urgent” announcements pushed to players
Results reported by players, then confirmed or disputed
Judging: penalties, internal notes and an activity log
Players join by code or QR code, with or without an account
Pairing and standings exports

leagues.title: Leagues that hold up over a season
leagues.description: A league runs for weeks, which is exactly what a shared spreadsheet handles worst. Joutes keeps the standings, reminds players and closes rounds on their deadline.
bullets: Points format: participation, win, loss and feats you define yourself
Killer format: assigned targets, eliminations, confirmation by the venue
Dated season, registration deadline, public league or invitation code
Standings recomputed on every reported match
Asynchronous rounds: each round is a multi-day window players schedule themselves
Automatic reminders before the deadline, and a set outcome for unplayed matches
Several organizers, several games, several venues

integrations.title: Your own tools keep working
integrations.description: Joutes is not a dead end: what you put in comes back out through an open API, an MCP server and exports, to feed your website, your Discord or your own tools.
bullets: Open, documented REST API (OpenAPI): events, venues, games, rules
Authentication via OAuth2 or a personal API key
MCP server to connect your AI agents to your data
Discord bot you can install on your server
CSV exports of pairings and standings
soon: Embeddable widgets for your own site: calendar, next event, league standings
